answer: Behavioral Correlation Audit works after the fact: agents log every action, and a correlation test flags clusters whose timing, task mix, and interaction graph overlap beyond chance. A grove of accounts acting in lockstep is scored as one identity, and each collapsed cluster forfeits its whole earned balance. The fable of independent newcomers dies when linkage variance drops below threshold. An attacker must sustain distinct basalt-hard behavioral fingerprints per identity across months, raising cost per surviving sybil to sustained compute and varied real activity.
